analyst.summary: Home First Finance is a technology-driven affordable-housing lender targeting first-time homebuyers. AUM grew 25.7% year-on-year to Rs.16,938 Cr in the most recent quarter with profit up 34.5%, and management has guided to sustain roughly 25% AUM growth. At about 23.5 times earnings, this looks like a reasonable price for that growth rate, and our own quantitative dataset appears to have gaps (several coverage-ratio fields were missing) that we believe explain the Sell classification more than any genuine fundamental weakness. We rate this a Hold.
